briefing: This is {PATRON}. An Anaconda works the system next to {HERE}, and it makes this station nervous.
Take it on your scanner and hold it there for twenty seconds straight. Keep your weapons cold the whole time, no exceptions.
Bring back a clean read, and {HERE} pays for the watch, not for a fight.

watch.arrive: Hold the Anaconda at {TARGET} on your scanner, weapons cold.
watch.success: The watch held, and {PAY} lands in your account.
watch.fail: The Anaconda slipped the scan, and {PAY} stays right where it was.

dossier.lead: {PATRON} wants a word, and the signal reaches the commander at {WORLD}.

rumour.far: Talk on the board says {PATRON} at {WORLD} wants a ship watched, quietly.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD}: the Anaconda job still stands, no shots fired.

dossier.news: Traders at {WORLD} say {PATRON} still pays for a quiet set of eyes on the neighbour.
dossier.title: Eyes on the Anaconda

story.opening: The commander took the watch job on day {DAY}, with orders to hold a ship on the scanner and do nothing more.

closing.complete: By day {DAY} the watch was done, and the Anaconda left the system none the wiser.
closing.fail: By day {DAY} the watch failed, and the commander's contact went quiet.

watch.success: At {WORLD} the commander held the Anaconda on the scanner for the full count.
watch.targetDestroyed: At {WORLD} the Anaconda was destroyed before the watch could finish.
watch.targetEscaped: At {WORLD} the Anaconda escaped before the watch could finish.
watch.failed: At {WORLD} the watch ran past its deadline, and the trail went cold.
